verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data API platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at docs.mx.com/mcp, which covers the core ask of connecting an agent via a first-party MCP server. The pack contains only that single probe line, with no detail on the server itself. Missing for 10: description of exposed tools or data scope, auth and setup instructions, supported clients or transport, independent or hands-on corroboration.
